To cite R
```{r}
citation()
```

Character vectors take priority when merging vectors of different types:
```{r}
a <- c(1, 2, 3)
b <- c("a", "b", "c")
c <- c(T, T, F)
c(a, b, c)
```

Working with dataframes with base R
```{r}
mycars <- mtcars
# structure
str(mycars)
# access elements via [row, col]
mycars[5, 4]
# access rows/cols
mycars[, 2] # col
mycars[1,]  # row
# subset via logical vec
# ex. all rows where column 1 is 21
mycars[mycars[1] == 21, ]
```

Run script.

```{bash}
Rscript src/week_2/Mean_adjusted_scores.R
```
